messages:
sarah: Quick follow-up from the observability ingest RFC — we prototyped a prefetch KV cache for trace/billing keys. Two outstanding questions: 1) when cache miss + ingest backpressure, do we drop/queue/re-route? 2) what's the duplicate-suppression TTL for fallback paths?

omar: +1. My take: prefer *re-route* to a lightweight late-enrich pipeline instead of dropping. Dropping loses cost attribution. But we need a way to mark these as 'fallback' so downstream can de-dupe.

kai: If we route to late-enrich we should attach metadata to avoid heavy rehydration. e.g. include `trace_id`, `service`, `sample_reason=kb_miss` and a `fallback_ttl` header. Query shape for cost lookups matters — cheaper to store a small envelope than re-run large joins.

alina: Ops note — we should gate this behind a rollout flag and circuit-breaker thresholds. If late-enrich queue grows > 10k we should flip to sampling or reject with `retry-after`. Also add `fallback_count` metric so we can track behavior.

omar: Suggested config (proto):
```
ingest.prefetch_kv {
  enabled: true
  cache_ttl: 60s
  fallback: "late_enrich"
  fallback_payload: ["trace_id","billed_service","sample_tag"]
  dedupe_ttl: 5m
}
```

kai: dedupe_ttl=5m sounds ok but for high-throughput tenants we might need shorter TTLs to avoid storage blowup. Can we make it tenant-configurable?

sarah: Tenant config per SLA tier makes sense — Dedicated customers get longer dedupe windows, prod free-tier smaller window. Will add to RFC.

alina: For rollout plan: 1) canary 1% on staging; 2) 5% production for non-critical routes; 3) monitor `duplicate_count`, `fallback_queue_length`, `ingest_rejects`. If `duplicate_count`/minutely rate > 0.02 then pause.

obs-bot: alert configured: `obs.prefetch.fallbacks > 100/min` -> #eng-platform / paging on-call.

omar: Edge case: if prefetch returns stale KV (race on update) we should attach `kv_version` and let consumers accept eventual consistency. Also prefer idempotent enrichment actions.

kai: Implementation note: keep the fallback envelope compact (<= 1kb) and avoid re-ingesting full spans. Use pointer to minimal event and schedule full enrich async.

sarah: Action items: @omar to draft config knobs PR, @kai to prototype compact envelope and storage plan, @alina to add alerts and rollout playbook. I'll update RFC doc with tenant TTL recommendation.

alina: acked. I'll add a runbook entry with `retry-after` semantics.

sarah: Thanks — let's reconvene in tomorrow's sync if any of the PRs hit big tradeoffs. :thumbsup:
